answer_1.quote: We tailor three tasks: conclusion generation, premise completion and premise generation, to construct an instruction-tuning dataset for inferential rule distillation.

answer_2.quote: For automatic accuracy evaluation of three tasks, we calculate BLEU score against reference responses.

answer_3.quote: We adopt GPT-4 as an evaluator to rate the generated responses on a scale from 1 to 3.
methods: rating on a scale from 1 to 3

answer_4.quote: We utilize Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) to recruit human annotators for manual verification.
answer_4.guideline: assess the clarity and comprehensibility of its premise and conclusion, as well as the logical entailment from the premise to the conclusion.
